steps.note: The milk is cooled to the temperature of the culture.
The milk is soured with lactic acid until the casein curdles and thickens it, as in yoghurt.

processing.text: This is the cultured buttermilk of a dairy, made from skimmed milk without churning, not the liquid left over from churning butter.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 13 Fermented milk products

sources.text: Tetra Pak gives the heat treatment of skim or low-fat milk; Wikipedia the pasteurising, homogenising, culture and souring. Neither gives an incubation temperature, time or final pH.
